excluded.reason: Duplicate of T-0610 in the bank export (same date 2026-06-24, description HOME DEPOT #4410 and amount -212.40). Only one receipt is on file for that purchase, and the statement balance only ties without it.

questions_for_client: We left out T-0611, a Home Depot charge of $212.40 on June 24, because it looks like a duplicate of T-0610 in the bank export. Please confirm there was only one $212.40 purchase that day.
assumptions: T-0611 is treated as a duplicate of T-0610 until the client confirms. With it included, the computed closing is 18823.21, which is 212.40 short of the statement closing of 19035.61.
T-0607 ADP PAYROLL (-5230.00) is over the BK-006 $5,000 threshold but matches the BK-008 default (ADP -> Payroll), so it was categorized, not escalated.
There is no Acme-specific rule for HOME DEPOT, so T-0602 and T-0610 use the BK-008 default, Repairs & Maintenance.
